content: Leave nothing hanging in your life, your Heavenly Father is very much concerned about the fine details of your life. Live your life with purpose, don't say 'what shall be, shall be', God is a God of detail He desires to perfect all that concerns you. Bring those area that you have neglected to Him, those things that are in the dark and have not been exposed to the light of His eternal Love. He is big enough to take care for the minutia of your life.

This day is yet another opportunity to walk out your full purpose in God. You cannot confine yourself to what others have done so far, all the progress in the world today has been from people who constantly stretch themselves to give the world something they have never seen. What you envision yourself doing is not only for you, its God showing the world through you that there is more, more Love, more excellence, more wealth, more miracles to express and bless the people. May all your dreams come to life.

Don't get lost in the notion that life is uncertain, you have the Holy Spirit within you, you are called out to know and be sure about life and where to go from here on out. You have the anointing of God, you will make it through to that expected destination, there is a place for you in Christ, where you stand out and shine in the fullness of who He called you to be, there is no need to try to be like anyone else, there is only one you. You are unique and valuable, you have a path of life and destiny no one else can fulfill.

Feel the warmth of God's Love all around you, never allow the cares of life to push you to the place that you feel God is not concerned about you, rather inform your finances, your health, your academics, your relationships etc of how much God loves you. Testify of the Blood that Jesus shed for you to bring wholeness in all that concerns you. Drown your fears in the excellence and power of the Love of God. Nothing can separate you from His Love.

Jesus is so interested in all the affairs of your life, yet He can bring to the areas that we allow Him to have Lordship over. He desires to bring His Lordship in our lives, this is a place where the reality of His reign is fully manifested. Let Jesus be more than just your Savior, He is the Lord, you can only reign in life to the degree that He is Lord over your own life. Submit your finances, your career, your marriage, your academics to the Lordship of Jesus Christ. You're reigning in life.

The Lord has great things that He desires you to know, there is a place for the secrets of God. So many are content with the surface knowledge of Christ, some even oppose anything that they have never heard or experienced, but the truth is there is so much more in God than we can ever imagine. The Father desires you to know Him in a Deeper way, that you may experience reality at a different level. Ask the Holy Ghost to take you deep, to the realm of His mysteries, there you'll find that it has always been God's plan for us to experience exceeding abundantly above all that we can ask or think.

You are the head and not the tail, in times past there has been so much of tail mentality in the Church, some have even felt that that's what constitutes the Christian life; barely getting by, being the last one chosen for anything, being sustained by miracles. Yet this is not the Purpose of the Life that we have in God, Jesus died to make as the First and the Best in all areas of our lives, you cannot be brought down, you cannot be on the losing end of Life, you have been brought to the class of excellence and glory, Through you God is showing the world His Power. Don't advertise God small, show forth His excellence in all that Concerns you.

You may at a place where things don't seem to be heading the way you what then to go, or routine has got you feeling mundane, you need a fresh gust of wind in your sail, today the Holy Spirit wants you to know that the Breath of God gives life, that same breath that made man a living being is available to you, embrace that breath over your career, you business your relationships and every sphere of your existence. That dry situation will live again, the barren land is receiving life and vitality. God made you to be productive and fulfilled in all that you do. The breath of God brings you life today, things are changes in your favor this very moment.

You are the best at being you, don't try to be someone else, so many people have lost who they are in an attempt to be someone else who they thought is better than them. What you may consider to better than you is just a person who has discovered there purpose and pursued it fully. Who you are doesn't has an image on Earth to which you can compare your destiny to, who you are is only found in Christ, He is the one who defines you. You are a Heaven class person, one of a kind.

This is your time to shine, you are called you show forth the Glory of God. You are the light of the World, God's will is for His people to show forth His excellence, your life is not a show of how many trials you can endure, it's a show of the beauty of perfection. Your walk is a walk of victory, from Glory to Glory. There is a life beyond compare refuse to settle anything that is not giving glory to God.

Have a Gospel consciousness, think of how the Gospel affects everything around you. See all things in the light of the death burial and resurrection of Jesus Christ. His death was not a religious act, His burial was not a final destination and His resurrection is not a fictional story. Jesus is alive, He is the resurrection and the life, see your life in this truth, all dead things are coming back to life. The Old is passed away and you are raised to new life again.

The Holy Spirit is not passive, He is an active Spirit, He is at work in you He is doing something right now on the inside of you, He knows all that you are pursing, He knows your desires and He longs To Help those dreams that God has placed in you to come to pass. He is the Power of the Godhead, yield to His leading and watch your life move to ending success and fulfilment.

What a great divine treasure that the Lord has giving unto us is form of His Written Word. Handed down for millennia, written by the hands of all kinds of people that the Holy Spirit moved upon, prophets, Kings, laymen, shepherds, fishermen, doctors, Etc. Tales of Faith, Prophecies fulfilled right before our very eyes, instructions on how Life is to be lived, blessed promises and the revelation of God. We never would have understood who He is without Him Sovereignly choosing to give us such a vital treasure. Get into this divine Book, dive deep into it and hear the heart of God for you, for the truth is God ordained it to reveal you, as you search for the Truth of God you find you've been looking in a mirror all along.

The Perfection of God is in Christ and we have been brought to oneness with Christ by the Holy Ghost. Therefore it is wrong for you to judge yourself as imperfect, because you are judging one that is a member of Christ. We have to discern the body of Christ, don't speak against Christ, declare the Glory of God that is in you. You are a member of His flesh and of His bones. You are one with Him. Perfection is come.

Don't fall for the trap of competition, immediately one does that they have left their lane and are trying to be someone else, your calls and directions in life are different. You can't compete with another person at doing life, because your purposes are different. Enjoy your uniqueness, and celebrate the success of others, cling to what the Lord has giving you to do, and be blind to all else. Determine to know nothing except what God has called you to. The race we run is not about who comes out first, it's about who finishes.

In life we face so many things, What is it that you are facing? There could be things that are weighing you down. That's the issue right there, you are FACING them. Take your eyes off of the situation and face Jesus. Lift up your eyes to Him see from His perspective. Gaze into all that He is and what He has provided for you. Face the Cross, there is victory for every area of your life, everything was sorted out right there. Face the Love of the Father, see how much you are prized by Majesty, God loves you. Face the truth of God's Word, let that be the standard of your life accept nothing less. Change what you are facing.

The concept that you have about your relationship with God is your definition of Christianity. If that relationship is something fragile and you hold it in you mind that it can break anytime, you'll live that way, fearful about the future trying to appease God. Righteousness gives us the ability to be bold, for we know He said He will never leave us nor forsake us, we can stand strong and confident in this truth because we know our access to God was never ours to make, it's through the blood of Jesus. Stand bold today receive all that's yours in Christ, hold the Glory of what Christ did for you ever before you, and rejoice in that liberty.

Do it, and do it today. What God has placed in you had to be brought out take steps towards that God given vision that's the only way you'll be to fulfil your destiny. Destiny is a collection of right steps, it doesn't matter how far you may seem today launch out you have the power of the Holy Ghost within you. Nothing can stop if hinder you it's your time to shine, you can and you will do it.

Jesus is the most precious gift that God gave to humanity. The value of anything can only be defined by the price that was paid to purchase it, you were bought at a price, this should lift your self esteem and perspective of your value. Don't lower your standards to what people think you should do with your life. You are defined by the One who bought you. Live your life only to bring glory to Him, Jesus sees treasure in you, treasure worth His life, live to that level of value, you are prized by Majesty.

The Lord is Holy, surrounded by holy angels that fall prostrate in worship and declare His Holiness. All that the Lord does is Holy, set apart for a divine purpose. Holiness is the fingerprint of God. Now you are born of Him, you are called His own, you are washed in the blood of Jesus, how could you be any different from that Holy nature of God. The mindset that you are working for Holiness, is not accurate. God has not called you to attain Holiness but rather to Walk in it. It is what God has made you, His presence makes you Holy.

You are powerful, more than you know. The limits you see or the things that seem insurmountable are more scared of you than you are of them. All Creation is very much aware of the power and presence of the Holy Spirit within you, He is power unlimited, possibility unfathomed. You have the third person of the Trinity living within you, and He is here to help you fulfill all that you desire to do. Draw from Holy Spirit today, reach deep inside you and find that the power that works in you is more than the task in front of you.

Don't get swept into the ideas of men, when making any decision there are 2 paths you can take, one is that which the word of God define for us and the other is yielding to the flesh and the senses. The Bible says for as many as are led by the Spirit of God they are the sons of God. We follow His leading inside us and we will never walk astray. We have a great Counsellor to teach us divine wisdom in every affair of life, you don't have to live by trial and error, the Holy Ghost will lead you into all Truth.

What we have gained in Christ Jesus, is far much more than that the world could offer, many say that in following Christ they have lost so much, that statement is itself is enough to describe where their treasures are, our relationship with God is more than anything that any man could offer, the satisfaction in Him is so much more than anything could give. All we have is all of Him, and that's more than we could even comprehend. Enjoy the fullness of His Grace.

That same power that through that ancient tomb wide open, that same breath that entered Jesus at the Resurrection, that same Spirit that rose Jesus from the dead dwells in you... You are a partaker of that very life, that very nature, that very experience of life in Christ. Being born again is not metaphorical, it is an actual experience and it's only when you are awakened to its reality that you'll be able to walk in the power of it. Paul by the Holy Spirit says reckon yourself to be dead to sin and alive unto God. Judge yourself that way, speak that reality over yourself and let it be all that you see.

All the Glory that heaven has, has the ability to coming to Earth and invading your life. It's more about your willingness and capacity to receive. If you have the mindset that Glory is for Heaven and life on Earth is just natural, you'll never know what God has in-store for you. When you asked Jesus to come into your life, you became a landing port for the Heavenly glory. By the very truth that Christ is in you, you have access to do experience life as it is in Heaven.

The mighty hand of God, is working in your favor. Some people have political advantage, others have people they know and who know them in positions of Influence, but as for you your favor is from God almighty. Talent and skill will get people so far, but by the grace of God you'll do more, you're ability is of God, you are well able, the excellence of the power at work in you is of God. You are favored beyond measure.

There are jewels in God, He has so many precious things He wants you not only to see but to actually have. You can walk out into a life of beauty beyond compare if you will just trust Him. Jewels are entrusted to people, they are not surface things, the things on the surface are for everybody, but the deep beauties of the Kingdom are kept for those who will seek them out.. Diligently, the Lord is calling you deeper! A greater level of fellowship awaits you!

You are solid gold, your value is not in the accolades that people have given you, its not even in the hidden potentials and talents that you have. You are the Treasure that God saw in Christ when He purchased you out of the World. You are as valuable as Jesus... And that's not a religious statement it is the truth for all eternity. The angels recognise the price that the Father paid for you and are in Awe. You are a true treasure in the Kingdom, a blessing to all creation, the darling of the universe. Valuable and loved by the Father.

The waiting is over, the fullness of time that you are waiting for has arrived. The more accurate understanding is that the fullness of time clocked when Jesus died. He consummated everything that mankind has ever waited for past, present and future. We now look back at the Cross, for there was when your healing, forgiveness, promotion, blessing, prosperity success, etc came. All you have to do is receive them now. Acknowledge that it is yours now and receive it.

Run with purpose, you are here for a reason every moment that you are living in a destiny moment it's an opportunity to reach for the fullness of all that the Lord has placed in side of you. Don't be passive about your destiny keep it ever before you, in every activity that you do today ask yourself, is this pushing me towards or away from my purpose? are these people slowing me down or helping me be all that I am called to be? The world needs you, Christ needs you, He sent you here for something so great. Be all that you are created to be.

Jesus came to give life more abundantly, there is a life that is over flowing, that gives life to all things around it, you are called to be a life giving spirit. There is so much receiving mentality in the Church, many feel ours is to receive healing, blessing, protection etc from the Lord. But in Christ we have been made givers, the Holy Spirit is in our lives to make us givers, that from our belly may flow rivers of living water, we give life everywhere we go, we are the light of the World. Today take time to give, be giving conscious, speak words of blessing to those around you, give encouragement and help to all that you come in contact with.

You can't claim to walk in Love and yet you are unwilling to believe the best in others, Love is not naive, but in its function it is higher than the the flaws and mistakes of others it sees the greatest outcome from any situation which is the perfection of that thing. Love breaks all the rules and brings all things into perfection. Your heart can be healed, that person can be forgiven, that relationship can be restored and the power will change you to the fullness of God! This Love passes knowledge it doesn't make sense to the human mind, it's Agape!

The things of God are permanent God does not do temporal fixes, we have to come to a place where we realise that this is the plan and purpose of God for every area of our lives, we are to hold fast to what the Lord has done for us, and know that it is permanent. It was at the same cross where the work of Salvation was completed that the work of healing, of blessing, prosperity and perfection were also accomplished. The Work of the Jesus in His death Burial and Resurrection accomplished for us more than what we are experiencing now. The Call of God is for us to accept the fullness of Christ and the Perfection that He wrought for us. That which is perfect is come.

The life that God has given us in Christ is not themed by chance. It's not by Chance that you are blessed or protected. Our relationship with God is very well planned and paid for. Jesus purchased our salvation, God delights in the prosperity of His own. All that we receive from the Lord is on the basis of what Jesus paid to provide, it is therefore rightfully yours. Don't be cheated out of what is yours, refuse sickness, refuse frustration, refuse to be in doubt or unclear about the future, Jesus paid a sure price and it is real and definite.

To fulfill great things in life it's not about moments of Brilliance, to have a lasting impact one must be consistent. Keep at it, always go back to the thing that the Lord spoke over your life, don't stop laying the bricks upon each other, that's how buildings are made one brick at a time. Hold the Word of the Lord ever before you and keep taking steps towards it, don't stop here, each step counts, be confident in Him who spoke it to you and walk out the destiny, the mountains will move, the valleys will be lifted, giants will fall Just keep moving forward your destiny is sure.

God placed us on Earth to do life with others, no man is an island, take time today to look around you and see the people that God has brought into your life. Gratitude will allow you to get more from life than demanding and expecting people to be and treat you a certain way. Send thanks to the people who have been there in your life. See the Fathers Love for you in Him sending the friends and family that you have!

Enjoy every moment, take time be thankful for where you are and all that you have, this is how to embrace the fullness of what the Lord is pouring out right now. Don't lose sight of that is in front of you right now in an attempt to reach for a greater future, what you have right now is enough for now, take full responsibility for it. Give yourself wholly to what is entrusted to you right now, more will entrusted to you as you are faithful.

Hold fast to what is true, refuse to accept anything contrary to the truth revealed to you by the Holy Spirit. You do well to heed to the teaching that is taught you of the Lord. There is guidance that we receive from Word of God that is for Christian life and living, then there is personal leading of the Holy Spirit at every step of your life, you have to be attentive to His leading, you take steps in the direction of where the Holy Spirit is taking you, for there is your specific fulfilment and destiny. This is your race to run, press into all that has been spoken to you of the Lord. Psa 23.

Get up and fight don't let life just pass you by, this is not a rehearsal every thing that you do or don't do counts for something. As a Christian you are not fighting for victory but rather you are fight from victory, God has already given you the land and it's up to you now to go and possess it. You have what it takes to live a fulfilled life, take the opportunities that the Lord has given you, push on to victory, greater is He that is in you than He that is in the world. Use your faith, set your eyes on the goal. You are born to win.

God is not man that He should lie or the son of man that He should repent. God doesn't just promise you something just to excite you, He is very intentional about all that He does. Unlike men who says one thing and does another, God's Words are His actions He speaks and it is. It's up to you and I to take that Word and appropriate it in our lives. You can stake your life on it. The Word is the person of Jesus Christ, He never fails.. Your victory is secure.

Salvation is a full package, the work that Jesus wrought in His death, burial and resurrection is complete. Everything that you could ever desire is in Christ! Don't look for your solution out there, turn your eyes to Jesus, He lives in you, He has given us all that we need, draw from the power and provision of Christ that is in you. Christ is in you doing big things, the Holy Spirit will lead you to all truth, all that you need has already been provided for. It is yours now.

The hold that Jesus has on you is more than the mistakes that you've made can warranty your separation from His Love. Declare His Love for you boldly for that is the foundation for our Faith in God, not that we loved Him but that He loved us and sent Jesus to die for us. This is where we stand, this is the place of our rest and security! God has His hand strong upon you, you are the object of His Love. He is so concerned about you, so you can lose the cares of your life, you both can't hold the steering wheel of your life, leave it all in His hands He is so concerned about you.

You may not have what it takes but you have WHO it takes to make it in life. One of the greatest revelations that you can get from life is that Jesus is the Way, you can do all things through Christ which strengthens you. Grace is the ability of God that causes you to function in the class of God, it is the divine enablement of God at work in a man, and Grace is the person of Jesus Christ. He is Grace, you have Who it takes to make it.

The next big thing on God's calendar is the return of the Lord Jesus, oh what a glorious day that will be, the Gospel is speading faster than before, and Lord is doing so many amazing things in the Church. He is coming back for a Church without spot or blemish, you are part of the Church and the Lord is doing a personal work is you. Keep walking this path of obedience and love, the Love of God is what brings us into perfection. It causes us to manifest the fullness of Who God has called us to be, there is no higher law than Love. Love is the Perfection, embrace it today!

You are Loved, you are the pursuit of the Fathers heart, never look down on yourself. The highest call for any being is to be Loved of God, and you individually are at the very center of His Affection. There is nothing that can ever separate you from the Love of God that is in Christ Jesus. Jesus died for one person, and that is you, if you were the only one in need of salvation He would have still come for you. The full benefit of what Jesus paid for at the Cross was for you. You are prized, the Father's Favorite child!

Come as you are to the King, He is the one who changes the hearts of men, no man has the power to change themselves only Jesus can do that. Now to us who are in Christ that transforming Power changed us from darkness into light this is the working of the Holy Spirit. It is His Power that also sustains us in this place of unending fellowship with the Father, never lose sight of what the God in Christ Jesus has done for you, it is a permanent work. Before you ever did everything righteous, He made you His righteousness embrace your identity and live it out.

God is Faithful, He is the author and perfector of our Faith. You can be sure that what you have trusted the Lord for shall be done for you! Because of who He is, if anyone comes to Him in Faith He can't deny them, because He can't deny Himself! He is the rewarder of them that diligently seek Him. God desires you to fulfil all that He has for you, your destiny is sure. He who promised is faithful.

It's a new season, the Old chapter is closed now we are stepping into the new, don't shy away from who God created you to be, you can start over right now and go back to the path He has for your life. A season comes with Knowledge you can start a new season right now. When you accept the knowledge of the truth something new is set into motion. Walk in the newness of life today. This is the first day of the best of your life.

The Greatest victory is in understanding that the victory has already been won, you are not trying to gain anything, you are called to realize that the battle has already been won, when Jesus cried "it is finished" it was finished, that statement rings true throughout all eternity. Its now up to you to appropriate the fullness of the work of Christ in your life. Refuse anything less than the reality that Jesus came to give. It is already yours, you are in Christ!

Words move the world more than you know, what is it that you are saying. We are a product of the words that we speak. In creation God used words, and set a principle in motion that words will be the carriers of creative power. What you say has a huge impact on the output of your life. Life and death are in the power of the tongue. Speak life, create what you desire. Your victory is in your mouth, you have the power to make it happen.
